test_scan_parquet_basic: test the pl.scan_parquet function to lazily scan a parquet file and collect results
test_row_index_operations: test pl.scan_parquet with row_index_name and with_row_index for adding row index columns
test_parquet_statistics_pushdown: test parquet predicate pushdown with statistics filtering on scan_parquet queries
test_parquet_schema_mismatch_handling: test handling of schema mismatches across multiple parquet files with extra_columns and missing_columns options
test_parquet_slice_pushdown: test slice and head pushdown optimization with row_index on scan_parquet queries
test_parquet_prefiltering: test parquet prefiltered decode with cast options and filter pushdown on scan_parquet
test_parquet_streaming_row_index: test with_row_index combined with streaming engine collect on scan_parquet
